cap.verdict: the MoE-with-CPU-experts class DOES fit this card (4.57 GB for a 35B) and its MTP head accepts at the same rates as the family (0.77/0.61, mean 3.4-4.1) — but with 16 GB RAM the expert band caps operational decode at 9.3/8.5 falling to 1.5 in deep agent turns, so the model spends 14+ minutes on tasks the 4B clears in 20 s. Verdict: viable to RUN on this card (first 35B here at all), not viable as a working slot while RAM is 16 GB; would become the smart-slot if the machine ever grows memory. Also: llama.cpp w/ CUDA has no MoE CPU-expert ping-pong penalty on this run — the hybrid attn KV stays tiny, specs do what they promise.
